tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background, the deepest layer: shell, title bar, status bar, tab strips, input wells, code blocks.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Window and panel fill. Default ground for Instrument content and for Manuscript prose.

tokens.name: panel2
tokens.usage: Raised layer: panel sub-headers, filter bars, inspector section headers, zebra rows (at 40%), popovers.

tokens.name: panel3
tokens.usage: Deepest-raised layer: empty states and drop targets only.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Every 1px line: window edges, dividers, tab separators, control outlines, dashed property separators. 1.34:1 on panel: structural only, never the sole carrier of meaning (flagged, kept from source).

tokens.name: borderHi
tokens.usage: Emphasised line: hovered controls, popover edge, major grid lines in the viewport.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text and values on bg, panel, panel2 and panel3 (15.9:1 on panel).

tokens.name: textDim
tokens.usage: Secondary text: inactive labels, meta lines, rail labels, secondary buttons. 5.6:1 on panel, 5.1:1 on panel2.

tokens.name: textMute
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: row indices, timestamps, kind tags, property keys, placeholders. 2.7:1 on panel, fails AA: use only where the same information is available elsewhere (flagged, kept from source).

tokens.name: textProse
tokens.usage: Manuscript body text (developer voice) on panel: a step below text to cut halation in long reading (12.7:1).

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: PRIMARY. Human attention needed: primary buttons, the active tab, rail item and selected row, pending review, focus ring. 8.1:1 on panel.

tokens.name: magenta
tokens.usage: AI-origin data, and nothing else. Always paired with an AI label or AI source. 5.8:1 on panel.

tokens.name: cyan
tokens.usage: Info and schema: type names, component rows, INFO log level, auto-approved. 13.6:1 on panel.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Approve and healthy: approve buttons, approved and canon status, pass validation, healthy pips. 11.8:1 on panel.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Reject and error: reject and danger buttons, ERR level, broken links, failed validation. 6.0:1 on panel.

tokens.name: yellow
tokens.usage: Warn and idle: WARN level, idle pips, mid significance, validation warnings. 13.3:1 on panel.

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Scripts and behaviour trees only. 4.9:1 on panel, 4.5:1 on panel2 (borderline, flagged).

tokens.name: onFill
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on any solid status fill (amber, green, red, cyan, magenta, yellow, violet buttons and badges).

tokens.name: sig-attention
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of amber. Components reference this name, never the hue.

tokens.name: sig-ai
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of magenta: AI-origin data.

tokens.name: sig-info
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of cyan: info and schema.

tokens.name: sig-approve
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of green: approve and healthy.

tokens.name: sig-reject
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of red: reject and error.

tokens.name: sig-warn
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of yellow: warn and idle.

tokens.name: sig-script
tokens.usage: Semantic alias of violet: scripts and behaviour trees.

tokens.name: panel-inworld
tokens.usage: Ground of the in-world voice block only: a warm near-black that separates what a people or an NPC says from developer truth.

tokens.name: line-inworld
tokens.usage: 1px edge and rules of the in-world voice block.

tokens.name: ink-inworld
tokens.usage: In-world text (the serif) on panel-inworld (12.4:1) and panel (12.7:1). Parchment, deliberately low-saturation: never amber, never used for UI.

tokens.name: ink-inworld-dim
tokens.usage: Attribution and speaker lines of in-world text on panel-inworld (5.9:1).

tokens.name: kind-world
tokens.usage: World entities: Tower, Band, Floor, Location, People, Faction, NPC, Artifact, Document, Creature. Telling these apart is the glyph's job. Low-chroma kind colour: glyph and hairline only, never a solid fill, never a status. ~10:1 on panel.

tokens.name: kind-truth
tokens.usage: Truth records (developer truth, T-xxx). Cold, like the shell. Low-chroma kind colour: glyph and hairline only, never a solid fill, never a status. ~10:1 on panel.

tokens.name: kind-belief
tokens.usage: Belief records (what a people holds, B-xxx). Warm, the in-world side of a truth. Low-chroma kind colour: glyph and hairline only, never a solid fill, never a status. ~10:1 on panel.

tokens.name: kind-clue
tokens.usage: Clue records (reveal vectors, C-xxx). Low-chroma kind colour: glyph and hairline only, never a solid fill, never a status. ~10:1 on panel.

tokens.name: kind-perspective
tokens.usage: Perspective records: lenses through a people, faction, NPC or author. Low-chroma kind colour: glyph and hairline only, never a solid fill, never a status. ~10:1 on panel.

tokens.name: kind-chronicle
tokens.usage: Chronicle records: dated history and event sequences. Low-chroma kind colour: glyph and hairline only, never a solid fill, never a status. ~10:1 on panel.

tokens.name: kind-beat
tokens.usage: Script and Beat records: the authored story sequence. Low-chroma kind colour: glyph and hairline only, never a solid fill, never a status. ~10:1 on panel.

tokens.name: kind-concept
tokens.usage: Concept and Version records: visual development, versions, two-state pairs. Low-chroma kind colour: glyph and hairline only, never a solid fill, never a status. ~10:1 on panel.

tokens.name: kind-template
tokens.usage: Template records: prompt and record templates. Near-neutral on purpose. Low-chroma kind colour: glyph and hairline only, never a solid fill, never a status. ~10:1 on panel.

tokens.name: el-earth-lo
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Earth/Nature band start (f 0.00, loam brown).

tokens.name: el-earth-hi
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Earth/Nature band end (f 0.20, moss).

tokens.name: el-water-lo
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Water/Ice band start (f 0.20, teal).

tokens.name: el-water-hi
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Water/Ice band end (f 0.40, deep blue).

tokens.name: el-fire-lo
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Fire band start (f 0.40, deep red).

tokens.name: el-fire-hi
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Fire band end (f 0.60, orange). Sits next to amber (dE 0.08).

tokens.name: el-fire-core
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Fire white-hot core.

tokens.name: el-air-lo
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Air band start (f 0.60, pale cyan). Sits next to cyan (dE 0.12). Grid Light: deepened to steel-teal so the band shows on a white ground.

tokens.name: el-air-hi
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Air band end (f 0.80, near-white). Grid Light: deepened to blue-grey; near-white would vanish.

tokens.name: el-lightning-lo
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Lightning band start (f 0.80, violet). Sits next to violet (dE 0.09).

tokens.name: el-lightning-hi
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Lightning band end (f 1.00, magenta). Sits next to AI-magenta (dE 0.06).

tokens.name: el-lightning-core
tokens.usage: DATA ONLY: 3D stage and data viz, never UI chrome or status. Lightning gold-white core.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: inst-panel-title

styles.name: inst-tab

styles.name: inst-button

styles.name: inst-label

styles.name: inst-label-sm
styles.usage: Inspector section names. Uppercase.

styles.name: inst-label-xs

styles.name: inst-chip

styles.name: data-lg

styles.name: data

styles.name: data-sm
styles.usage: Meta lines, status bar, review bodies, code blocks.

styles.name: data-xs
styles.usage: Row indices, kind tags, type annotations, badges.

styles.name: rail-label
styles.usage: Activity rail labels only. Uppercase.

styles.name: ms-title

styles.name: ms-h2

styles.name: ms-h3
styles.usage: Sub-heading inside a record.

styles.name: ms-body

styles.usage: Developer prose (the truth voice). Max 70ch, colour textProse.

styles.name: ms-meta

styles.usage: Captions, notes and asides under prose.

styles.name: ms-mono

styles.name: iw-title
styles.usage: Title of an in-world text (a book, a song, a letter).

styles.name: iw-body

styles.usage: Anything a people, faction, NPC or in-world author says. ink-inworld on panel-inworld. Max 62ch.

styles.name: iw-attribution
styles.usage: Who says it. ink-inworld-dim.

spacing.note: A 2px base taken from the source; Instrument works in 2 to 16, Manuscript in 12 to 48.

tokens.name: sp-2
tokens.usage: Hairline gaps: badge padding, rail glyph to label.

tokens.name: sp-4
tokens.usage: Row padding (tree, property), chip gaps, toolbar groups.

tokens.name: sp-6
tokens.usage: Button icon gap, button rows, filter bar padding.

tokens.name: sp-8
tokens.usage: Default gap inside rows; button side padding (sm).

tokens.name: sp-10
tokens.usage: Panel inner padding, console padding, status bar side padding.

tokens.name: sp-12
tokens.usage: Tab side padding, review card side padding, button side padding (md).

tokens.name: sp-14
tokens.usage: Tree indent per depth level.

tokens.name: sp-16
tokens.usage: Button side padding (lg), Manuscript block gap.

tokens.name: sp-20
tokens.usage: Voice block side padding.

tokens.name: sp-24
tokens.usage: Manuscript paragraph group gap, record header padding.

tokens.name: sp-32
tokens.usage: Gap between Manuscript sections.

tokens.name: sp-48
tokens.usage: Manuscript page top and side margin at wide widths.

radius.note: Instrument is square. Manuscript content surfaces take 2px; chrome stays square in both registers.

tokens.name: radius-instrument
tokens.usage: Everything in the Instrument register and all chrome in both registers: windows, tabs, rail, buttons, chips, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-manuscript
tokens.usage: Manuscript content surfaces only: voice block, link chips in prose, the [[ popover, inline code. Softens long reading without leaving the Grid Noir family.

tokens.name: shadow-hot
tokens.usage: A window or card that holds unread human-attention items (the review queue with pending entries).

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Floating layers only: the [[ popover, menus, tooltips. Pair with a borderHi edge.

tokens.name: h-control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, segmented controls in dense bars.

tokens.name: h-control
tokens.usage: Default button, input, select and icon button.

tokens.name: h-control-lg
tokens.usage: Large buttons.

tokens.name: h-tab

tokens.name: h-titlebar

tokens.name: h-toolbar
tokens.usage: Preset toolbar under the title bar.

tokens.name: h-statusbar
tokens.usage: Status bar.

tokens.name: w-rail

tokens.name: h-rail-item

tokens.name: measure-prose

tokens.name: measure-inworld
